<style>
html, body {
    max-width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}
/* 
   Pontes Miranda Advogados - Stylesheet
   Design: Premium Boutique (Light Beige, Dark Green & Gold)
   Author: Antigravity AI
*/

:root {
    --bg-primary: #f5ede3;       /* Nude Principal (Tonalidade areia suave) */
    --bg-secondary: #faf6f0;     /* Nude Claro (Tonalidade creme/off-white) */
    --bg-tertiary: #ebdcc9;      /* Nude Escuro (Contraste de argila/areia escuro) */
    
    --text-main: #1c1d1f;        /* Preto Grafite */
    --text-muted: #4e5156;       /* Cinza Escuro */
    --text-subtle: #7a8286;      /* Cinza Prateado */
    
    --card-bg: #ffffff;
    --card-border: rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.25);
    --card-border-hover: rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.5);
    
    --gold-primary: #b5babd;     /* Prata Principal */
    --gold-light: #e2e8f0;       /* Prata Claro */
    --gold-dark: #7a8286;        /* Prata Escuro */
    --gold-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #b5babd 50%, #7a8286 100%);
    --gold-glow: 0 0 20px rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.15);
    
    --green-primary: #121212;    /* Preto Principal (botões, cards de diferenciais/floating) */
    --green-dark: #0a0a0a;       /* Preto Profundo (cabeçalho, footer, etc.) */
    --green-light: #1e1e1f;      /* Preto Suave (fundo de cards escuros) */
    
    --silver-primary: #b5babd;
    --silver-light: #ffffff;
    --silver-dark: #7a8286;
    --silver-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #b5babd 50%, #7a8286 100%);
    
    --font-title: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
    
    --header-height: 80px;
    --border-radius: 8px; /* Slightly more geometric boutique feel */
    
    --transition-fast: 0.2s ease;
    --transition-normal: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    --transition-slow: 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* Base resets */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    font-size: 16px;
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
}

body {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-main);
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* Typography elements */
h1, h2, h3, h4 {
    font-family: var(--font-title);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: var(--text-main);
}

p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

img {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
}

/* Layout Utilities */
.container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

.text-center {
    text-align: center;
}

/* Header & Navbar */
.header {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--header-height);
    background: #000000; /* Preto absoluto inicial */
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    z-index: 1000;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
}

.header.scrolled {
    height: 70px;
    background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.97); /* Levemente mais claro ao rolar, bem sutil */
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
}

.header-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

.nav-logo {
    height: 52px;
    width: auto;
    object-fit: contain;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
    filter: none; /* Mantém a logo em prata */
}

.header.scrolled .nav-logo {
    height: 44px;
}

.nav-menu {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 32px;
}

.nav-item {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    position: relative;
    padding: 8px 0;
}

.nav-item:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.nav-item::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 1.5px;
    background: var(--gold-primary); /* Prata */
    transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

.nav-item:hover::after {
    width: 100%;
}

.header-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
}

.btn-nav {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-radius: var(--border-radius);
    background: #ffffff; /* Fundo branco */
    color: #000000; /* Letras pretas */
    border: 1px solid #ffffff;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
}

.btn-nav:hover {
    background: var(--gold-primary); /* Prata */
    color: #000000; /* Letras pretas */
    border-color: var(--gold-primary);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.mobile-toggle {
    display: none;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.nav-btn-mobile {
    display: none;
}

/* Sections - Global */
section {
    padding: 100px 0;
    position: relative;
}

.section-header {
    margin-bottom: 60px;
    max-width: 700px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}

.section-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2.5px;
    color: var(--gold-primary);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-title {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    color: var(--text-main);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.section-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO SECTION - BRAND NEW REFATORED CODE
   ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.hero-section {
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding-top: calc(var(--header-height) + 20px);
    padding-bottom: 50px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-container {
    max-width: 1360px; /* Sessão hero mais larga */
}

.hero-grid-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
    gap: 40px; /* Maior espaçamento */
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
}

.hero-text-col {
    padding-right: 20px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.hero-headline {
    font-family: var(--font-title);
    font-size: 3.4rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--text-main);
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.gold-text-highlight {
    color: var(--gold-primary);
    font-style: italic;
    font-family: var(--font-title);
}

.hero-text-support {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-top: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    font-weight: 400;
    max-width: 600px; /* Aumentado para equilibrar o layout */
}

.hero-ctas-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 24px;
}

/* Primary WhatsApp CTA Container */
.primary-cta-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

.btn-whatsapp-hero {
    background-color: #25D366; /* Cor oficial do WhatsApp */
    color: #ffffff;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; /* Centraliza o texto */
    gap: 0;
    padding: 16px 48px; /* Botão mais largo/alto */
    border-radius: 50px; /* Totalmente arredondado */
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.25);
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 60px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    white-space: nowrap; /* Impede que o texto quebre linha */
}

/* Proposito CTA Button */
.proposito-cta {
    margin-top: 32px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
}

.btn-whatsapp-proposito {
    background-color: #25D366; /* Cor oficial do WhatsApp */
    color: #ffffff;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; /* Centraliza o texto */
    gap: 0;
    padding: 16px 48px; /* Botão mais largo/alto */
    border-radius: 50px;
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.25);
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    min-height: 60px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-whatsapp-proposito:hover {
    background-color: #20ba59; /* Verde levemente mais escuro */
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.35);
}

.btn-whatsapp-proposito i,
.btn-whatsapp-proposito svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.btn-whatsapp-hero:hover {
    background-color: #20ba59; /* Verde levemente mais escuro */
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.35);
}

.whatsapp-hero-icon {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.whatsapp-hero-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.whatsapp-hero-label {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.95rem; /* Texto ligeiramente maior */
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.whatsapp-hero-phone {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.whatsapp-hero-bubble {
    background-color: #eae5db;
    border: 1px solid rgba(197, 168, 128, 0.25);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    text-align: center;
    display: inline-block;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
}

/* Secondary CTA Button */
.btn-message-hero {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #cbd5e1 50%, #94a3b8 100%);
    color: var(--green-primary); /* Texto Preto */
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 12px 28px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 58px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2),
                0 0 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

.btn-message-hero:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f1f5f9 50%, #cbd5e1 100%);
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    color: var(--green-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 25px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45), 
                0 0 25px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

.btn-message-hero::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -150%;
    width: 60%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), transparent);
    transform: skewX(-25deg);
    animation: metallicShine 4.5s infinite ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes metallicShine {
    0% {
        left: -150%;
    }
    50% {
        left: -150%;
    }
    100% {
        left: 250%;
    }
}

.message-hero-icon-box {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: inherit; /* Herda a cor do texto do botão */
}

.message-hero-icon {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
}

.message-hero-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.message-hero-label {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.message-hero-sub {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.65);
}

/* Hero Right Side: Image and absolute OAB badges */
.hero-image-col {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 600px;
}

.organic-photo-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 400px; /* Exact 2:3 ratio width */
    height: 600px;    /* Exact 2:3 ratio height */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.organic-photo-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; /* Since container ratio matches image, cover displays the whole photo */
    object-position: center;
    border-radius: 32px; /* Elegant rounded rectangle shape */
    border: 1.5px solid var(--gold-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(27, 50, 44, 0.08);
    z-index: 10;
    position: relative;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
}

.organic-photo-img:hover {
    transform: scale(1.01);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(27, 50, 44, 0.12);
}

.organic-photo-decor-line {
    position: absolute;
    top: -12px;
    left: -12px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: -12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.35); /* Thin elegant silver outline */
    border-radius: 40px; /* Offset rounded rectangle matching image shape */
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
}

.organic-photo-wrapper:hover .organic-photo-decor-line {
    transform: scale(1.02) rotate(1deg);
}

/* Small solid dot on the outline, matching reference image */
.organic-photo-decor-line::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 30%;
    left: -5px;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background-color: var(--gold-primary);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.5);
}

/* Floating Card for Areas of Actuation */
.areas-floating-card {
    background-color: var(--green-primary); /* Preto */
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius);
    padding: 28px 48px; /* Card mais largo */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 40px;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 25;
}

.floating-card-title-col {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding-right: 30px;
}

.floating-card-tag {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--gold-primary); /* Prata */
    display: block;
    width: 100px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.floating-card-separator {
    width: 1px;
    height: 52px;
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); /* Separador Prata sutil */
    margin-right: 30px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.floating-card-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 20px 40px; /* Maior gap */
    width: 100%;
}

.floating-card-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    gap: 6px;
    color: #ffffff; /* Letras brancas */
    transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

.floating-card-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    color: var(--gold-light);
}

.floating-card-item i {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    color: var(--gold-primary); /* Prata */
}

.floating-card-item span {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------
   OTHER SECTIONS - ADAPTED TO LIGHT BOUTIQUE DESIGN
   ------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Diferenciais Section */
.diferenciais-section {
    background-color: var(--bg-secondary);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.03);
}

.diferenciais-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
}

.diferencial-card {
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius);
    padding: 32px 24px;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
}

.diferencial-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    border-color: var(--card-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03), var(--gold-glow);
}

.diferencial-icon-wrapper {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    background: rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.08); /* Prata */
    border: 1px solid rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.2);
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    color: var(--green-primary); /* Preto Grafite */
    transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

.diferencial-card:hover .diferencial-icon-wrapper {
    background: var(--green-primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: transparent;
}

.diferencial-icon-wrapper i {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
}

.diferencial-card h3 {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    color: var(--text-main);
}

.diferencial-card p {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Nosso Propósito / Institucional Section */
.proposito-section {
    background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.02);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.02);
}

.proposito-container {
    max-width: 900px; /* Tighter layout for single-column readability */
}

.proposito-content-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}

.proposito-title {
    font-size: 2.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    color: var(--text-main);
    text-align: center;
}

.proposito-text {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 760px;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------
   SOCIAL CARD (TWEET UI) - KOKONUT UI PORTED TO PLAIN CSS
   ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.social-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 40px auto 0 auto;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.1);
    border-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
    text-align: left;
    transition: var(--transition-normal);
    position: relative; /* For simulated cursor overlay */
}

/* Simulated cursor overlay for auto-demo click animation */
.simulated-cursor {
    position: absolute;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    margin-top: -3px;
    margin-left: -4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 100;
    transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), opacity 0.4s ease;
    opacity: 0;
}

.simulated-cursor.active {
    opacity: 1;
}

.simulated-cursor svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.15));
    transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    transform-origin: top left;
}

.simulated-cursor.clicking svg {
    transform: scale(0.85);
}

.social-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(27, 50, 44, 0.05);
    border-color: rgba(181, 186, 189, 0.3); /* Prata */
}

.social-card-body {
    padding: 28px;
}

/* Author block */
.social-card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.social-card-author {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.social-card-avatar {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    object-fit: cover;
    background-color: #000000;
}

.social-card-author-info {
    line-height: 1.3;
}

.social-card-name {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-main);
}

.social-card-username {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-subtle);
    font-weight: 400;
}

.social-card-more {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--text-subtle);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: var(--transition-fast);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.social-card-more:hover {
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
    color: var(--text-main);
}

.social-card-more i {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
}

/* Post text */
.social-card-text {
    font-family: var(--font-title);
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--green-primary);

/* Floating WhatsApp Button with premium animations */
.floating-whatsapp {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    background-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.5), 0 0 60px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.25);
    z-index: 50;
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    animation: entryAnimation 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 1s forwards;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0);
}

.floating-whatsapp:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.6), 0 0 80px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.35);
}

.floating-whatsapp:active {
    transform: scale(0.95) !important;
}

.floating-whatsapp .whatsapp-icon {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* White filter utility for in-page WhatsApp buttons */
.img-icon-white {
    object-fit: contain;
}

.floating-whatsapp-pulse {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    border: 2px solid #25d366;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -2;
    animation: pulseRing 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.floating-whatsapp-glow {
    position: absolute;
    top: -24px;
    left: -24px;
    right: -24px;
    bottom: -24px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.45) 0%, rgba(37, 211, 102, 0) 70%);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -3;
    animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.whatsapp-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    right: 80px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(10px);
    background: #1c1d1f;
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.floating-whatsapp:hover .whatsapp-tooltip {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes entryAnimation {
    0% {
        transform: scale(0);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes pulseRing {
    0%, 100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
    50% {
        transform: scale(1.25);
        opacity: 0;
    }
}

@keyframes glowPulse {
    0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.6;
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.9;
    }
}
